detail.longDescription: I built security defenses my blog doesn't need: a dummy bcrypt hash, HMAC'd IP buckets, magic-byte MIME sniffing, log-string sanitization, timing-safe bearer comparison. I knew that since working on them, but did it anyway, to learn them somewhere a mistake doesn't cost anything. None of them has needed maintenance since, and none of them prevented an incident either. What I'd keep if I started over, and what I wouldn't: https:// roland.leth.ro/blog/tech/what- id-do-differently # WebDev
